title: Interest accrual instruction succeeded [Beta]
description: This event occurs when an interest accrual instruction is successfully processed with product interest engine. With reversal true, the non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual is reversed. With reversal false, nothing is changed and the same amounts are only informed.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization. Present only when the instruction was sent with the x-external-account-id header.

instruction_id.title: Instruction ID
instruction_id.description: Client-provided instruction identifier, unique within the organization and program

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Free-text reason informed in the instruction

reversal.title: Reversal
reversal.description: When true, the amounts were reversed. When false, the amounts were only informed and nothing was changed.

interest_net_amount.title: Interest net amount
interest_net_amount.description: Account-level net non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual, within the instruction scope. Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places, and 0 when there is none.

interest_gross_amount.title: Interest gross amount
interest_gross_amount.description: Account-level gross non-capitalized accrued interest already published as accrual, within the instruction scope. Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places, and 0 when there is none.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Unique division identifier. Present only when informed in the instruction.

division_code.title: Division code ID
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization. Present only when informed in the instruction.

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: UTC date and time the instruction was processed, as an ISO local date-time without offset. Fractional seconds appear when present.
